lines.text: Wisdom calls out in the street and the square, and speaks at the city gates.
Wisdom says that if they had repented, she would have poured out her spirit and made her words known.
Wisdom will mock and sneer when their dread comes like a storm and their destruction like a flood.
Wisdom will not answer them, because they hated instruction and chose not to fear the LORD.
Whoever listens to Wisdom will dwell in safety, secure from the fear of evil.
